title: Reka Edge was presented with chat documentation and a linked model resource
summary: On 2026-03-15, Reka Edge was presented through a dedicated Reka app page alongside Reka's chat overview documentation and a linked external resource. This marks a material development step for Reka Edge because it connects a named offering with an accessible product surface and usage documentation. The exact capabilities, release status, and contents of the external link remain unverified.
